text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The exhaustion—became clearly evident
as the Tenno Sho (Autumn) drew near."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Blehhhh, nothing's working...
Not my legs, not my brain...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Bestie, what's wrong?!
You've only done one run today.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Aaah~, how do I put it... Lately,
it's like everyday misery, or like I've got chills?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Fwehhh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, bestie!?
Helios, are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: We carried Daitaku Helios to the nurse's office and laid her down on the bed. And then—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Given that training regimen, I think it was inevitable that things would end up like this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Why!? I was doing it together with her, you know?
So why only my bestie...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Even if your wills are aligned,
your two bodies are not the same.
Daitaku Helios is originally...
choice_data_list: So it's because I'm a miler, huh?
I guess it's because I'm a miler?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...That's correct.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios specializes in sprint and mile
distances. Truth be told, pushing up to 2000m
is about the absolute limit she can manage.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: If I continue training for medium distances matched with Palmer-san, following the Takarazuka Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No way... But my bestie never looked like she was in pain
even once during all our summer runs together...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: And yet, why...
choice_data_list: They must have held back for my sake...
They must have held back for our sake...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's painful, it's for friendship.
Because that's just the kind of Umamusume Daitaku Helios is.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Patience...? Is that so...?
In my view...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Man, I to~tally forgot about that♪
Here it is☆

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: That's what it is, isn't it? I knew it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Helios!? Are you okay to be out of bed!?
Wait, you forgot...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Man, you know how it is. When you're totally in the zone, your brain just goes into overdrive, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Running with you had me so hyped my brain totally checked out☆
Guess I completely ignored the distance♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Bestieee~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems it wasn't self-sacrifice after all... but there's no doubt Daitaku Helios was pushing herself too hard for the sake of friendship.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Helios... um, look. If that's the case,
maybe it'd be better if I entered the Tenno Sho (Autumn) alone...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna push my bestie any harder than this.
So...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh... Palmer, all by yourself?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I see... So that's how it is...
And we're right here...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Daitaku Helios looked up at the ceiling, mouth agape—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Uh, no way, right? That's, like, completely and utterly out of the question, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Helios... why...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I mean, my bestie can't really go all out
on her own, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It's the Tenno Sho, right? And my opponents are super tough, right?
Like, the pressure is seriously unreal.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Tbh, Pal-chin...
Isn't it kinda early for you to go solo casual mode?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ugh, that's...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Even if you say you can do it, Palmer-chin,
I won't believe it. I mean...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Because I know you♪
Way better than you know yourself, Palmer-chin☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —She saw right through her. Because she values friendship so much, Daitaku Helios understands Mejiro Palmer better than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer still doesn't have
the peace of mind to truly enjoy the
Tenno Sho (Autumn) on her own...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Plus, y'know! Doing crazy-hard training
with Palmer-chin is totally making me
insanely strong too! ★

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
There's somethin' I just gotta see
once the two of us blast through this tunnel!
And that isâ

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: You and me sweeping 1st and 2nd, and a super-powered up Palmer-chin going, "How ya like that, huhhh!"♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"My desire to watch from right beside you is totally at MAX☆
And I'm definitely not giving up those front-row arena seats♪
Because—"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I'm Palmer's number one bestie for life, after all☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Helios...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after collapsing, Daitaku Helios's resolve
seemed entirely unshaken.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
But can her body really hold up? Seeking her
opinion, I turn to look at Ikuno Dictus—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
A doctor would probably advise you to hold back.
However... I am no doctor.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I think decisions should be made while taking individual feelings into account.
That style of management...
is what I prefer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"What I like." That was the keyword
I had been chasing all along.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Mejiro Palmer loves.
What Daitaku Helios loves.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Casting aside duty, breaking down the barriers of the heart, and chasing after the passions once nearly buried—that brings me here, today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Then—
choice_data_list: Let's give it our all in the Tenno Sho (Autumn), Helios.
Let's do our best at the Tenno Sho (Autumn), Helios!

text_block_list.name: Palmer & Helios
text_block_list.text: Trainer!
choice_data_list: Let's cherish what both of them love.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, as expected☆ Totally feeling ya～
Our vibes are in sync～♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, BFF! I'll run with you until
you can burst out laughing all on your own in a race☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Until I see this through to the end, I ain't stoppin' for nothin'★ That's a super-duper pinky promise!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Besties... Yeah, yeah, please...
As long as you're by my side, I...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Let's get hyped up for the Tenno Sho (Autumn) together!
Got it?! It's a promise!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, their high-wire act of friendship continues. The rope
the two walk may be thin—but it is extraordinarily strong.
